request.name: Measured food preservation and storage
request.function: Preserve an actual owned known-safe food batch through a physically implemented process, and inspect its remaining condition and storage life. Retain real material losses, provenance and uncertainty; do not infer safety from appearance or dryness.
request.conditions: I have two units of berries with observed nutrition 8 and toxicity 0, but their current decay value is only 12.39360888. Two owned roots have decay 54.80596867. A previous plum drying assay was invalidated when its sample spoiled before stable readings. My calibrated comparison balance and passive drying tray remain at their remembered locations; I am not currently beside them.
request.inputs: Actual owned food and any explicitly acquired necessary materials or reachable apparatus. Suitable preservation methods and additional inputs are unknown.
request.costs: Unknown; specify finite paid processing stages, actual energy and material requirements, ongoing spoilage during processing, and interruption behavior.
request.effects: Enable a feasible preservation trial with measurable changes to the actual food's water content, deterioration and subsequent storage life. Preserve nutrition and toxin accounting consistently with the real process. Failed or inadequate processing must remain possible and observable; no automatic safety certification or satisfaction.

projects.question: Can locally available tested materials provide useful relief during rest?
evidence: At tick 128, paid measurement established branch item-117-sol-674's usable length bounds of 1.25–1.35.
At tick 131, the same branch failed its actual 1.2-span load test with a 0.2-unit stone load and its own weight.
The test recorded deflection 0.03290403, permanent damage, no fracture and safeCapacity 0.
projects.uncertainty: This result applies to the tested unit and configuration, not all branches or other materials.
projects.goal: Investigate useful refuge materials without compromising survival reserves.
completedSteps: Learned resting-shelter and specimen dimensional metrology.
Measured one branch and completed its paid load test.
outputs: Specimen-specific dimensional and failed load-response records.
projects.missing: Suitable structural members, tested roofing and lash materials.
projects.next: Reconsider feasible refuge materials after refreshing food reserves.
projects.pauseReason: The measured branch did not demonstrate useful capacity in the tested configuration.
projects.benefit: Established a real structural limitation; no refuge relief demonstrated.

projects.question: What can calibrated relative drying measurements establish about an actual food sample?
evidence: The balance passed calibration at tick 73.
Paid readings at ticks 84 and 87 were both 0.2 with resolution 0.05.
At tick 88 the assay was invalidated because the actual sample spoiled or disappeared.
projects.uncertainty: No certified stable residue estimate, composition result, or safety conclusion was obtained.
projects.goal: Obtain a valid relative drying measurement without compromising survival reserves.
completedSteps: Constructed and calibrated a comparison balance.
Obtained two paid sample readings before invalidation.
outputs: Two relative mass readings from an invalidated assay.
projects.missing: A surviving sample and sufficient stable readings.
projects.next: Replenish known safe food before deciding whether another sample is worthwhile.
projects.pauseReason: The plum sample spoiled before assay completion.
projects.benefit: Reusable apparatus remains; no food-safety benefit was demonstrated.
